base.policy: Unadopted research base. Exact existing PIL256/ImageNet/FP32/native bilinear softmax transfer/fiber-priority inference, no new weights or member search. Keep frozen classwise3 quality reference.

eligible_pixels.boundary_band: cv2.dilate(raw_fiber,uint8 ones square(2R+1),BORDER_CONSTANT0) XOR cv2.erode(raw_fiber,same kernel,BORDER_CONSTANT0); current raw fiber=raw_mask==2
eligible_pixels.protection: Only raw mask0 or2 in band AND0.1<=P2<0.9. Raw stone class1, high-P2 fiber and strong low-P2 background unchanged. No seeds or no eligible pixels => raw output. No temporal/GT/template/FOV requirements.
eligible_pixels.over_budget: Entire-frame raw fallback before sampling for BOTH nonraw arms. Never select top-k pixels or tune budget from GT.

filter.neighbor_step_native: d=max(1,floor(min(H,W)/400+0.5)); native integer neighbor coordinates, no extra resampling or resized RGB for weights
filter.spatial5_weight: 1 for each in-bounds neighbor,0 outside; normalize including center
filter.rgb_edge5_weight: exp(-mean_channels((I_neighbor/255-I_center/255)^2)/(2*sigma^2)) for each in-bounds neighbor,0 outside; center weight1; normalize
filter.vector_update: M=normalized weighted mean of ALL3 native fiber-expert probabilities; Fnew=(1-alpha)*Fcenter+alpha*M only at eligible pixels. Freeze outside E. No positive-only score bias, no class-wise hue/blue identity veto, no learned color histogram or local prototype fitting.
filter.class_mapping: Keep raw stone pixels1. At eligible raw0/2 pixels: if argmax(Fnew)==2 =>2; otherwise restore1 if unchanged stone-expert argmax==1 else0. Class ties use numpy argmax first index, identical order0/1/2. Raw fiber protection atP2>=0.9 applies even if class competition differs elsewhere.
filter.changed_area_fallback: If total changed class pixels>floor(0.01*H*W), return entire raw mask and record rejected proposal counts, without reporting rejected mask as adopted. Independent frame, no temporal persistence.
filter.policy: Exactly5 current-image samples per eligible pixel, no full-native 5xRGB/3class shifted tensor stack when E sparse. Neural output remains75percent of mixed vector. Appearance only controls neighbor influence. White/low-saturation allowed, no inferred hidden pixels.

geometry_and_history: Not used for pixel selection, identity or filling in this finite experiment. T1 pose can be missing/wrong even with high qN; its frozen results remain independent diagnostics. Width-ratio reversal analysis is NOT an approved observer fix. No optical flow/new state or T1 threshold changes.

limitations: Cannot edit P2<0.1 FN or P2>=0.9 FP, raw stone protection conflicts, entirely no-seed images, wrong high-confidence identity or learned missing tip appearance. Even perfect edits inside E are oracle bounds, not achieved accuracy. Current RGB difference can preserve a wrong high-contrast spot. Not expected to solve all fiber errors or prove unique-instance geometry.
